reasons.plausibility: The mechanism aligns with known selective oxidation phenomena in Al/Cr-containing alloys, though attributing it primarily to high configurational entropy has some minor uncertainties.
reasons.testability: Comparing mass gain, oxide scale composition, and morphology across HEAs with different Al/Cr contents under identical oxidation conditions provides a clear and feasible way to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It pinpoints a practical composition-based strategy for enhancing oxidation resistance in HEAs, making it a valuable hypothesis to investigate further.
